manage.noResultsYet: No results yet — they appear here as timekeepers stamp finish times.

manage.infoUploadNotConfigured: Upload isn't set up — paste an image URL instead.

manage.competitionInfoHint: General information about the competition and contact details for participants.
manage.trailsHint: Descriptions of the race trails, course maps, and route information.
manage.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this group? Its members return to the available pool.
manage.heatsBoardHint: Drag competitors between heats to organise them. On a wide screen the heats sit side by side. Times are edited on the Results tab.
manage.scoresEditHint: QC: tap a time to correct it against the camera / manual record. Ranking updates automatically.
manage.substituteReviewHint: Someone raced in another competitor’s place? Record the stand-in below before you approve — the swap follows through to the public results, the downloads and the Hall of Fame.
manage.substituteEditHint: Tap a name to record a stand-in who raced in that competitor’s place; times are left as they were measured.
manage.substituteHint: Record a stand-in who raced in this competitor’s place
manage.derivedColumnsHint: Rank, total time and status are worked out from the times — correct a time and they follow.
manage.heatStartsHint: A total is the finish time minus the heat's start, so correcting a start re-times everyone in that heat — and every heat that was sent off with it.
manage.removeFromResultsConfirm: Take {name} out of the results? They keep their place in the heat and their recorded times, and you can put them back at any time.
manage.notInResultsHint: Marked as not having raced — scratched at the start line, or taken out here. They aren't ranked and don't reach the public results.
manage.closeHint: The last step of the year. The results are filed in the Hall of Fame, where they are read exactly like every previous year, and the whole season — the roster, the relay groups, every heat with its recorded times — is archived in the database. These screens then start the next competition empty.
manage.closeKeeps: Nothing is thrown away, and nothing else is reset: the categories, staff accounts, contacts, trails and the Hall of Fame all stay as they are. Take the Excel download first if you want the year on your own machine.
manage.closeConfirm:
Close the {year} competition?

The roster, heats and recorded times are archived in the database and cleared from these screens. The {year} results stay public in the Hall of Fame.

This ends the year — opening registration again starts {next}.
manage.closeNotPublished: Publish the results first. Closing files the year away under the results as published, so there has to be something to file.
manage.closeDone: The {year} competition is closed and archived. Its results are in the Hall of Fame — open registration when you are ready for {next}.
manage.closedBanner: The {year} competition is closed and archived — that is why these screens are empty. Open registration on the Registration tab when you are ready for {next}.
manage.archiveSummary: · closed {date} · {competitors} competitors · {heats} heats · {results} results in the Hall of Fame
manage.fixTitle: Correct a time in a closed competition
manage.fixHint: A leg timed wrong — spotted on the photos, or from someone who knows what they ran. Correcting it here fixes the year's archive and re-publishes it, so the leg, the total, the placings, the records and the medal table all move together. Editing the result below on its own would be undone the next time the year is re-imported.
manage.fixCompetitorPlaceholder: Name as it appears in the results
manage.fixPreviewHint: {competitor}'s leg corrected to {time}. Nothing is saved yet.
manage.fixApplied: Done — {competitor}'s time is corrected and {entry} is republished.
manage.fixAppliedTotals: Their total went from {before} to {after}. Open the Hall of Fame to see it.
manage.fixPickTeam: That name raced more than once that year. Which one?
manage.fixErrorNoArchive: That year has not been closed and archived, so there is nothing to correct here. A competition still running is corrected on the Scores tab.
manage.fixErrorNotFound: Nobody by that name in that year. Check the spelling against the results below.
manage.fixErrorAmbiguous: That name raced more than once that year.
manage.fixErrorNoLeg: The archive has no leg recorded for them, so choose swim, bike or run above.
manage.fixErrorNoStamp: That leg was never timed for them, so there is no time to correct.
manage.fixErrorNoPrevious: The time this leg is measured from was never recorded, so this leg cannot be worked out.
manage.fixErrorSplit: Enter the time as minutes:seconds, e.g. 7:10.
manage.createGroupHint: Choose who swims, bikes and runs. All three legs must be filled so the runner is clearly defined. The same person can take two legs (e.g. one swims and bikes while a teammate runs).
manage.createGroupIncomplete: Assign someone to all three legs (swim, bike, run).
manage.createGroupFailed: Couldn't create the group. Try again.
manage.groupIncomplete: Incomplete group — a leg is unassigned.
manage.groupNoRunner: No runner assigned — assign a runner before the finish line.
manage.groupsBoardHint: Drag competitors between groups to assign them. Dropping onto a taken cell replaces the occupant — they return to the unassigned tray. Drag to the tray to remove from a group.
manage.unassignedTrayEmpty: Everyone is assigned to a group.
manage.pickedHint: Picked {name} — tap a cell to place them.
manage.lotteryHint: Form random teams from the ungrouped competitors in this category.
manage.lotteryConfirm: Form random teams from the ungrouped competitors in this category? Existing groups are left unchanged.
manage.lotteryAllHint: Form random teams from every ungrouped competitor, across all team categories.
manage.lotteryAllConfirm: Form random teams from every ungrouped competitor in all categories? Existing groups are left unchanged.
manage.assignPickHint: Assign anyone to this leg. Someone already in another group is added here too (e.g. runs in one group and swims in another).
manage.combinedStartsHint: Categories with only a few competitors can share a start so the pool goes in full. Tick heats from different categories and combine them: they keep their own rosters and each competitor is still ranked only inside their own category — the start line just sends them off together with one GO.
manage.selectForCombinedStart: Pick this heat for a combined start
manage.heatsSelected: {count, plural, =0 {No heats picked} one {# heat picked} other {# heats picked}}
manage.confirmSplitWave: Split this combined start so each heat goes off on its own again? Nobody leaves the race and no times are touched.
manage.combineOverCapacity: Combined, these heats put {total} competitors in the pool — more than the {capacity} lanes. Combine anyway?
manage.combineStartedError: A heat that has already been sent off can't be combined. Cancel its start first.
manage.combineFailed: Those heats could not be combined.
manage.combinedStartNotice: Combined start — this heat goes off, and is cancelled, together with
manage.mergeCategoriesTitle: Race two age brackets as one category
manage.mergeCategoriesHint: Only a few children in each age bracket? Race them as a single category — one field, one ranking, one podium. Only brackets of the same race can be joined (children’s singles with children’s singles), never a relay with a solo race or a child with an adult. Everyone still registers in their real age bracket, so this can be undone at any time. Heats you have already organised are kept as they are.
manage.confirmMergeCategories: Race {brackets} as a single “{merged}” category? They will be ranked together in one list, so there is one set of places for the merged field. Heats already organised are kept — put them in the same heat, or give them a combined start, whenever you are ready. Nobody has to re-register, and you can split them back later.
manage.confirmUnmergeCategories: Split {brackets} back into separate categories, each ranked on its own again? Heats and times are left alone and nobody has to re-register. Anyone you moved into the other bracket’s heat while merged will be ranked with that bracket, so move them back if needed.
manage.mergeAlreadyTimed: This can’t be changed once timing has started — it would re-rank results that are already being recorded. Cancel the starts first if you really need to.
manage.mergeNotSameFamily: Only age brackets of the same race can be merged.
manage.mergeFailed: Those categories could not be merged.
manage.exportWorkbookHint: One .xlsx — competitors, teams, heats, results, contacts
manage.waitingForHeatsTitle: Registered but not in a heat
manage.waitingForHeatsHint: These teams and competitors are registered but have no place in a heat — usually because they signed up after the heats were built. Place them into a heat below, or press the button to fill the spare lanes automatically. Nothing already arranged is moved or renamed.
manage.maybeAlreadyPlaced: Someone of this name is already in a heat — check before placing
manage.confirmPlaceDuplicate: A heat already holds an entry called "{name}". Place them anyway?
manage.waitingNonePlaced: Nobody was placed — the ones left are flagged as possibly already in a heat, so place them one by one.
